===== MASTERY CONTENT BRIEF =====

[HOME PAGE]

Features section label: WHY MASTERY
Features section heading: A fairer platform for teachers and learners
Feature 1 title: Learn from verified experts
Feature 1 body: Browse on-demand courses, live streams, and 1-to-1 coaching sessions — all in one place. No subscription required.
Feature 2 title: Earn more, keep more
Feature 2 body: Instructors keep 85% of every sale. No big marketplace cuts, no need to build your own website or grow your own audience from scratch.
Feature 3 title: Free to browse, pay per course
Feature 3 body: Students pay only for what they want. Free livestreams and intro content let you try before you buy.

Announcement bar (if editable): Instructors: First 3 months FREE — no upfront cost. Start teaching today.

[ABOUT US PAGE]
Label: OUR MISSION
Headline: Empowering everyone to master something new
Body paragraph: Mastery is a two-sided learning marketplace connecting qualified instructors — the Masters — with students who are ready to level up. Whether you are a certified personal trainer who has never had a platform, or a professional looking to pick up a new skill, Mastery is built for you.
Body paragraph 2: We believe expertise should be accessible and teaching should be rewarding. Instructors keep 85% of what they earn, students pay per course with no subscription, and the platform works hard for both sides. No ads. No noise. Just learning.

FAQ section heading: How Mastery works
FAQ 1 question: Is Mastery free for students?
FAQ 1 answer: Yes. Creating an account and browsing is completely free. You only pay for the courses or sessions you choose to take — no monthly subscription required.
FAQ 2 question: How do I become an instructor?
FAQ 2 answer: Sign up as a teacher, complete your profile and bio, and create your first course. Your first 3 months are free — no subscription cost until you are up and running.
FAQ 3 question: How much does Mastery charge instructors?
FAQ 3 answer: £5.99 per month after your free trial, plus a 15% commission on each sale. You keep 85% of everything you earn.
FAQ 4 question: Who can teach on Mastery?
FAQ 4 answer: Any qualified professional or skilled individual — personal trainers, tutors, coaches, musicians, photographers, developers, and more.

Pillar 3 heading: We bring the students, you bring the expertise
Pillar 3 body: You do not need to build an audience from scratch. Mastery puts your courses in front of learners actively looking for what you teach.

How it works label: BECOME AN INSTRUCTOR
How it works heading: 4 steps to start teaching on Mastery
Step 1 title: Create your account
Step 1 body: Sign up and choose Teach on Mastery. It takes minutes and your first 3 months are completely free.
Step 2 title: Build your profile
Step 2 body: Write your bio, upload your qualifications, and add a short intro video. A strong profile builds trust with students straight away.
Step 3 title: Create your first course
Step 3 body: Upload video content, set your pricing, and publish your first Mastery course or coaching offering. We guide you through every step.
Step 4 title: Start earning
Step 4 body: When students enrol, you earn. Payments are processed securely and you keep 85% of every sale — paid out on a regular schedule.

Bottom section 1 heading: For students
Bottom section 1 body: Join free, browse every course, and pay only when you find something you love. No subscription, no ads.
Bottom section 2 heading: For instructors
Bottom section 2 body: Start with 3 free months, then just £5.99/month with a fair 15% commission on sales. Everything you need in one place.

[FAQS PAGE]
Section heading: Common questions

Student questions:
Q: Is it free to join Mastery as a student?
A: Yes. Creating an account is completely free. You only pay when you choose to enrol in a paid course or book a 1-to-1 session.

Q: What types of content can I access?
A: On-demand video courses, live instructor streams (free to watch), and bookable 1-to-1 coaching sessions. Free introductory courses are also available in most categories.

Q: What is Mastery's refund policy?
A: We offer a 14-day refund window on digital courses. If you are not satisfied, request a refund within that period. Live session refund eligibility depends on cancellation timing.

Q: Do I need to pay a monthly subscription as a student?
A: No. Students pay per course or session only — no subscription, no hidden fees.

Instructor questions:
Q: How much does it cost to teach on Mastery?
A: £5.99 per month after your free 3-month trial. Mastery also takes a 15% commission on each course sale — you keep 85%.

Q: What qualifications do I need to teach?
A: There are no blanket qualification requirements, but we encourage instructors to list their credentials. For certain categories like fitness or tutoring, Mastery offers a verification service so students can see your qualifications are genuine.

Q: Can I offer more than one course under the same subscription?
A: Yes. Your £5.99 per month covers unlimited course and service listings — you do not pay extra per course.

Q: How and when do I get paid?
A: Payments are processed securely in-platform. Earnings minus the 15% commission are paid out on a scheduled basis to your registered account.

Q: Can I cancel my instructor subscription?
A: Yes, at any time from your dashboard. Your profile and content remain visible until the end of the paid period.
